description.value:
Created by the Cat Lord—a divine being of the Upper Planes—to blend the qualities of humanoids and cats, tabaxi are a varied people in both attitude and appearance. Swift, curious, and observant, they travel far and wide to gather stories, relics, and experiences.

Adapted to D&D 2024 (5.5e) rules: ability score increases and starting languages come from your character's Background and origin choices rather than species traits.

Tabaxi Traits

Creature Type: Humanoid
Size: Medium (about 5–7 feet tall) or Small (about 3–4 feet tall), chosen when you select this species
Speed: 30 feet, and you have a Climb Speed equal to your Speed (30 feet)

As a Tabaxi, you have these special traits.

Darkvision. You have &Reference[Darkvision] with a range of 60 feet.
